simple.meaning: יַרְדֵּן (Yardên) appears 183 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with priesthood.

definitions.short: Jarden , the principal river of Palestine
definitions.full: H3383. Yarden יַרְדֵּן 182 proper name, of a river Jordan (according to Rel Ol § 215 c , from ירד with ןֵ֯ for original ןַ֯ , compare ᵐ5 ὁ Ιορδανης ; = river as flowing downward, descending , then of particular stream as river Κατ’ ἐξοχήν . See also Sta § 294 e ( ןֵ֯ for ןֶ֯ , but name according to Sta non-Hebrew)) — absolute always ׳הַיַּר in prose Gen 13:10 162t.; with ה locative הַיַּרְדֵּ֫נָה Judg 8:4 3 t.; יַרְדֵּן only Psa 42:7 ; Job 40:23 ; construct יַרְדֵּן Num 26:3 11 t. Numbers Josh + 1Chr 6:63 ; — the river of Palestine: in all periods, chiefly Hexateuch (122 t.: Genesis 5 t. J; Numbers 20 t. P, 1 t. J E; Deuteronomy 26 t.; Josh 34 t. J E, 20 t. D, 16 t. P), Judges (12 t.), and Samuel (18 t.); in Kings 13 t.; Chronicles 7 t.; elsewhere 10 t.; — הַזֶּה הַיַּרְדֵּן Gen 32:11 (J), Deut 3:27 ; 31:2 ; Josh 1:2 , 11 ; 4:22 (all D); הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּעֵבֶר Gen 50:10-11 , (J), Josh 7:7 ; 24:8 (both J E), + 20 t. D + Judg 5:17 ; 10:8 ; 1Sam 31:7 ; P has also הַיַּרְדֵּן מֵעֵבֶר Num 32:19 , and ׳מֵע לַיַּרְדֵּן 32:19 ; 32:32 ; 35:14 ; Josh 14:3 , also 17:5 (JE), 18:7 (D), Judg 7:25 ; 1Chr 12:37 ; 26:30 ; in P peculiarly יְרֵחוֺ יַרְדֵּן the Jordan of (at) Jericho , with עַל Num 26:3 , 63 ; 31:12 ; 33:48 , 50 ; 35:1 ; 36:13 , with לְ מֵעֵבֶר 22:1 ; 34:15 ; Josh 13:32 ; 20:8 (= 1Chr 6:63 ), with מִן Josh 16:1 (E?); הַיַּרְדֵּן עֵבֶר Isaiah 8:23; Deut 4:49 ; Josh 13:27 (P); see below עבר ; הַיַּרְדֵּן מֵי 3:13 (twice in verse); 4:18 , 23 (all J E), 3:8 ; 5:1 (both D); הַיַּרְדֵּן מֵימֵי 4:7 (JE); הַיַּר ׳גְּאוֺן Jer 12:5 ; 49:19 ; 50:44 ; Zech 11:3 (see גאון a, above); ׳הַיּר שְׂפַת 2Kin 2:13 ; הַיַּרְדֵּן יַד וְעַל עַלהַֿיָּם יוֺשֵׁב Num 13:29 (J E; elsewhere in Numbers, P); הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּכַּר the circle of Jordan , i.e. the plain about Jericho Gen 13:10-11 , (J), 1Kin 7:46 ; 2Chr 4:17 ; הַיַּר ׳מַעְבְּרוֺת Judg 3:28 ; 12:5-6 , fords of the Jordan ; יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי אֶלעֵֿבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶלגְּֿגְּלִילוֺת Josh 22:11 , compare 22:10 (both P; see גלילות above); יַרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ Psa 42:7 (without article only here and in following); אֶלמִּֿיהוּ יָגִּיחַיַרְדֵּן Job 40:23 a Jordan bursteth forth into his mouth.
